subject: maths
title: Interior & Exterior Angles of Polygons
welcome_lead: Polygons with more sides have more angles. Learn the formulas for any number of sides.
meta_desc: Master interior and exterior angles of polygons in this KS3 geometry adventure.

concepts.def: Angle inside the polygon at a vertex.
Angle outside, between an extended side.

walkthroughs.body_html:
For a polygon with n sides: sum = (n − 2) × 180°.

For a pentagon (n = 5): sum = (5 − 2) × 180 = 540°.

walkthroughs.h2: Each interior angle of regular polygon
walkthroughs.body_html:
Each angle = sum ÷ n.

For a regular hexagon: sum = (6 − 2) × 180 = 720°. Each angle = 720 ÷ 6 = 120°.

Exterior angles of any polygon sum to 360°.

For a regular polygon, each exterior = 360 ÷ n.

Regular hexagon: 360 ÷ 6 = 60°.
